name: sample
description: The three requests from the brief.

name: morning_up_peak
description: Office morning: 13% of population per window, almost all from the lobby.

name: lunch_two_way
description: Lunchtime: balanced up and down traffic, the hardest pattern for control.

name: evening_down_peak
description: End of day: high rate for a short time, nearly everyone heading to the lobby.

name: interfloor
description: Quiet interfloor traffic between upper floors, no lobby involvement.

name: capacity_stress
description: Two small cars, a burst of lobby arrivals: cars fill and passengers get left behind.

name: tall_building
description: The 51-floor building implied by the brief's sample, beyond a single bank's comfort.

name: tall_lobby_traffic
description: 51 floors, lobby-only trips (no interfloor), so a zoned bank can serve every request.

name: office_day
description: One office day in ten windows: morning up-peak, quiet, lunch two-way, quiet, evening down-peak.

name: office_day_parked_lobby
description: The office day with idle cars always returning to the lobby.

name: office_day_scheduled
description: The office day with parking that follows the time of day: lobby in the morning and at lunch, mid-building when quiet, high in the evening.

name: morning_up_peak_parked
description: Same morning traffic; idle cars return to the lobby (park_floor=1).

name: tall_lobby_zoned
description: Same lobby-only traffic; three local cars (1-26) and three express cars (lobby + 27-51).
